skills.name: credible-analysis-overview
skills.description: How Credible organizes the published semantic models you query, from organization and workspace down to a source and its dimensions, measures, views and joins, plus the Credible-specific retrieval…
headings: You only ever see published packages
Retrieval judgment the tool descriptions don't carry
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Credible 已发布语义模型从组织、工作区、来源到维度、度量、视图和关联的组织层级，供查询发现使用。

skills.name: malloy-analysis-pitfalls
skills.description: Common data analysis pitfalls to watch for during query construction and result interpretation. Reference this checklist when verifying queries and results to catch errors before presenting an answer.
skills.description_zh: 提供数据分析常见陷阱检查清单，用于构造查询、解释与核验结果，避免输出前遗漏错误。

skills.name: malloy-analysis
skills.description: Workflow for answering data questions against Malloy semantic models over MCP - structured discovery with get_context, query construction with execute_query, verification, and answer delivery. Use…
skills.description_zh: 通过 MCP 对 Malloy 语义模型开展问数，依次使用 get_context 发现数据、execute_query 构建执行查询，再核验并交付答案。

skills.name: malloy-charts
skills.description: Chart selection guidance and renderer reference for Malloy views. Use when choosing visualization types, adding chart annotations, user asks "what chart should I use", "how should I visualize this"…
skills.description_zh: 为 Malloy 视图选择图表、设置注释并查阅渲染器参考，适用于可视化方式选择。

skills.name: malloy-gotchas-queries
skills.description: Common Malloy query and view mistakes. Read BEFORE writing views, queries, or notebooks. Covers chart constraints, aggregate filters, joined field aliasing, method syntax, and time truncation vs…
headings: Joined Fields in `order_by`: Must Alias First
Dotted Paths Must Name a Declared Join
`order_by:` Can Only Name an Output Column
DRY: Define in Source, Reference in View
`?` Alternation: Use Commas to Combine Filters
Fields Within a Clause: Commas or Newlines, Never Semicolons
skills.description_zh: 在编写 Malloy 视图、查询或笔记本前检查常见错误，包括图表约束、聚合过滤、关联字段别名、方法语法及时间截断。

skills.name: malloy-gotchas-rendering
skills.description: Common Malloy renderer annotation mistakes. Read BEFORE adding chart annotations, formatting tags, or building dashboards. Covers tag syntax, scale rules, sparkline setup, and big_value patterns.
headings: `# big_value` Needs `# label` on Each Measure
skills.description_zh: 在编写 Malloy 图表注释、格式标签或看板前检查渲染错误，涵盖标签语法、比例尺规则、迷你图和 big_value 模式。

skills.name: malloy-patterns
skills.description: Index of Malloy documentation topics. Use to discover what's available in search_malloy_docs. Covers language reference (sources, queries, views, fields, aggregates, joins, filters, expressions…
skills.description_zh: 索引 Malloy 文档主题，帮助确定 search_malloy_docs 的检索内容，包括来源、查询、视图、字段、聚合、关联、过滤和表达式。

skills.name: malloy-phrase-detection
skills.description: How to construct search targets for the get_context tool. Covers target-type classification and non-obvious decomposition patterns. Read the tool description for field definitions and the end-to-end…
skills.description_zh: 指导为 get_context 构造搜索目标，识别目标类型并拆解不明显的查询短语。

skills.name: malloy-queries
skills.description: Malloy query patterns, syntax rules, and chart annotation reference. Consult before writing or debugging any query. Covers dates, aggregates vs dimensions, join paths, filters, string matching, and…
headings: Truncation accessors return timestamps, not integers
skills.description_zh: 提供 Malloy 查询模式、语法及图表注释参考，适用于查询编写与调试，覆盖日期、聚合/维度、关联路径、过滤和字符串匹配。
